## Headers

- [ComputePlan.h](ComputePlan.h): Where Core ML placed each op of a loaded model, read back through MLComputePlan (macOS 14.4 / iOS 17.4, ML::hasComputePlan()). (declares `ComputePlan`, `toString`)
- [Model.h](Model.h): macOS 13 / iOS 16: the engine-only compute units and output backings. - [MultiArrayNative.h](MultiArrayNative.h): declares `toShape`, `toDType`, `nativeArray`, `adoptOutput`
- [Options.h](Options.h): Which devices Core ML may place a model's ops on. (declares `ComputeUnits`, `Options`, `Result`)
